commits.author: Imesha Sudasingha
commits.message:
Fix security configuration for Spring Boot 3.x migration

- Add explicit CorsConfigurationSource bean to ensure CORS works at
  the security filter level (Spring Security 6 no longer delegates to
  MVC @CrossOrigin for preflight requests)
- Use explicit AntPathRequestMatcher for /error and /login to avoid
  ambiguous matcher selection between Ant and MVC matchers
- Set server.error.include-message=always to preserve error reason
  messages in ResponseStatusException responses (Boot 3 defaults to
  NEVER)
- Make @EnableMethodSecurity(prePostEnabled = true) explicit to clearly
  document RBAC enforcement
- Add Lombok annotation processor path for maven-compiler-plugin 3.14+
- Add spring-security-test dependency for MockMvc JWT testing
- Fix test files: update renamed method, constructor, and deprecated
  @MockBean annotation

commits.author: Claude
commits.message:
Upgrade to Spring Boot 3.5.0 and Spring Security 6

Major changes:
- Upgrade Spring Boot from 2.5.3 to 3.5.0
- Upgrade Java from 1.8 to 17 (required for Spring Boot 3.x)
- Upgrade Auth0 java-jwt from 3.11.0 to 4.4.0
- Remove junit-vintage-engine exclusion (not needed in Boot 3.x)

Security configuration changes:
- Replace WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter with SecurityFilterChain bean
- Replace @EnableGlobalMethodSecurity with @EnableMethodSecurity
- Replace authorizeRequests() with authorizeHttpRequests()
- Replace antMatchers() with requestMatchers()
- Update to lambda-based security DSL

Update README with:
- Java 17 requirement
- Spring Boot 3.x migration documentation
- Code examples for the new security configuration pattern
